steps.name: libx264-software-name
steps.subject: libx264 registers as libx264_sw
steps.description:
The name libx264 goes to this project's H.264 encoder (hardware through the Android codec bridge,
software otherwise), so applications that ask for libx264 by name get it; the x264 encoder stays
available as libx264_sw, which that encoder uses as its software fallback.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Inappropriate [makes room for the Android hardware codec under the name applications ask for]

steps.name: android-codec-registration
steps.subject: Register this project's Android hardware codecs (H.264/HEVC encode and decode, VP9 decode)
steps.description:
The codecs run on Android's MediaCodec through the shared codec client (shared/media, placed into
libavcodec by the recipe's overlay as moto_codec.c and moto-codec-client.h); this patch adds them to
the build and to the codec list, the automatic encoders ahead of the software ones.

dep3.X-Rungic-Status: Inappropriate [Android host specific: MediaCodec through the APK]
